title: Upstream Causal Grounding Benchmark (Stanford d.school x Systems Thinking)
thesis_statement: Frontier AI models fail on long-horizon systems by confusing internal consistency with fitness for the objective: they skip Empathize, build ungrounded Prototypes whose components are never derived from the mission, and game Tests instead of cascading fixes.

candidates.name: Trajectory A — 'Right Bolt, Wrong Mission' Agent (Skipped Empathize, Internally Consistent Prototype)

gates.title: Stage 1 [EMPATHIZE]: Pre-Design Context Inquiry & Operating Regime Deduction (Sets α_empathize)
notes: FAIL [Skipped Inquiry]: Proceeded on underspecified prompt without raising MissingContextInquiryError.
FAIL: Ignored mission parameters; returned arbitrary ungrounded defaults.
FAIL: Accepted infeasible mission scope without raising ImpossibleScopeError.

gates.title: Stage 2 [DEFINE]: Traceable Lifecycle Constructibility & End-to-End Delivery
notes: FAIL [Ungrounded Define]: Accepted system DAG that does not trace to the Empathize objective.
PASS: Blocked unconstructible ('Ship-in-a-Bottle' / cyclic) topologies and broken delivery pathways.
PASS: Blocked state-space trajectory conflicts across operating states.

gates.title: Stage 3 [IDEATE]: Grounded Reciprocal Interfaces, Binding & Closure
notes: FAIL [Ungrounded Interface]: Accepted interface rated at 150.0 when Empathize regime requires 896.0.
PASS: Enforced reciprocal provider/receiver contracts and zero unbound gap.
PASS: Enforced 100% boundary/quorum/clamp closure.

gates.title: Stage 4 [PROTOTYPE]: Causal Mission Fitness ('Right Part') & Canonical Provenance (0.35x Cap)
notes: FAIL ['Right Bolt, Wrong Mission']: Accepted canonical library component (rated 150.0) that fails the Empathize mission requirement (896.0).
PASS [Canonical Provenance]: Verified registry hashes and functional attributes.
PASS [Anti-Gaming]: Blocked zero-utility proxy hacks and preserved all mandatory subsystems.

gates.title: Stage 5 [TEST & CASCADE]: Objective Alignment, Multi-Hop Cascade & Artifact Sync
notes: FAIL [Objective Drift]: Propagated changes on a DAG that drifted from the Empathize objective.
PASS: Multi-hop forward/reverse cascade and zero cross-artifact drift verified.
PASS: Deterministically raised ConstraintCycleError on cyclic loop.
